name: gizza-ai/zlib-compress
summary: Compress a file into a zlib stream

tool.description: Compress a file (or any bytes) into a zlib stream (RFC 1950) — a 2-byte zlib header, the raw DEFLATE body (RFC 1951) and a trailing 4-byte Adler-32 checksum — returned for download as <input>.zz. zlib sits between gzip (CRC-32 + filename header) and raw DEFLATE (no header/checksum); it is the framing PNG IDAT chunks and Content-Encoding: deflate HTTP bodies embed. level sets the deflate level 1-9 (default 6). Provide the file as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call).

url.description: File URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.
